customManagers.description: app-template splits an image into repository and tag. The kubernetes manager reads only a flat image: line and helm-values reads only a values file, and a ResourceSet is neither, so without this the pin never moves and nothing reports it.

packageRules.description: Use semver-coerced versioning for docker images
Kavita: filter out nightly/canary tags; stable releases are bare X.Y.Z[.W]. Use loose versioning to compare 4-segment hotfixes like 0.8.9.1 correctly.

Tika: hold at 3.x until tika-client speaks Tika 4 (stumpylog/tika-client#87); Tika 4 dropped /tika/form/* so paperless-ngx fails every Office parse with a 404. Docker versioning keeps the -full variant, which semver-coerced drops by coercing 3.3.1.0-full to 3.3.1.

Gotenberg: hold at 8.x until paperless-ngx ships a gotenberg-client that speaks Gotenberg 9; Gotenberg 9 dropped /forms/pdfengines/*, which paperless calls to merge converted Office and email documents.
Valheim: merging this image restarts the game server, so it lands when nobody is playing. platformAutomerge must be off or GitHub queues the merge at PR creation and the schedule is ignored.
